note: Dominica: a non-national must first obtain a work permit from the Labour Division, valid for a year and renewable, conferring residence where the employment runs over six months (Invest Dominica, the government's investment agency). No days of work without it are named. OECS citizens work freely (the oecs list, first); other CARICOM artistes and musicians of the participating states on the Skills Certificate (the csme list).

sources.title: Invest Dominica Authority, Work and Residency Permit
sources.said: Non Nationals wishing to engage in work in Dominica must first obtain a work permit from the Labour Division. If hiring a non national, a work permit is required. A work permit automatically confers residency status if the term of employment lasts for more than six months. All work permits are valid for one-year duration and can be renewed.
